climate: Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

notes: Uco Valley wines are deep in color, intense in aroma and rich in flavor.
With Luján de Cuyo, it is the source of Argentina's most highly rated Malbec.

blurb.text: A wine area in Valle de Uco, in Mendoza, with Los Chacayes, San Pablo and Vista Flores inside. Malbec dominates plantings at 55%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon (12%) and Chardonnay (5%).
